title: Why Is the Media Ignoring the New Rape Allegation Against Trump?
author: Justin Baragona
content:
Good evening, and welcome to this week's **' Ragebait.'**

**Justin Baragona** here. In tonight's edition, we look into the mainstream
media blackout over an on-the-record rape allegation against Donald Trump - a
blackout that would almost certainly not exist for any other president in
history (especially a Democratic one). Also, CBS News commits more "unforced
errors" with its deleted Angie Nixon tweet, and Hasan Piker finally pulls the
trigger on his Scott Jennings lawsuit.

On Monday morning, Democrats on the House Judiciary Committee
[released](https://zeteo.com/p/donald-trump-is-newly-accused-of) a jaw-
dropping report about **Donald Trump 's** longtime ties to deceased sexual
predator **Jeffrey Epstein** , including a brand new allegation that the
president brutally raped a young beauty pageant contestant.

"The bottom line: there is more than sufficient evidence to launch a criminal
investigation," the Judiciary Democrats [wrote in the
report](https://democrats-judiciary.house.gov/sites/evo-subsites/democrats-
judiciary.house.gov/files/evo-media-document/2026-10.hjc-dems-staff-report-
epstein-and-trump.pdf), calling for an independent special counsel to
investigate and prosecute the president's alleged criminal activity alongside
Epstein.
